Works like an L2: lower the Threshold to make it louder — the level goes up by (ceiling − threshold) and a look-ahead brickwall stops every peak at the Out Ceiling. ARC makes the release follow the music. IDR rounds the output to the bits you choose (for YouTube 24 bit is right).
